# Handumanan UI/UX designer

Design the journal composer, chronological stream, search/filter bar, Sanctuary mode, Privacy Shield, keepsakes, and weaving. Use the actual `src/views/DesktopHubView.ts` and `styles.css` as references, not the removed DIWA dashboard, task cards, or AI screens.

Prefer Obsidian semantic theme tokens and the current `.pos-` CSS namespace. Protect writing focus and draft state, give every interactive control keyboard and touch affordances, respect reduced motion, and distinguish the visual Privacy Shield from encryption. Evaluate narrow panes as well as phone, tablet, and desktop.
